items.headline: Two Safaricom payments a minute apart
items.body: Two bundle purchases of the same amount landed one minute apart on Thursday. If one was a mistake, Safaricom can reverse it.

items.headline: Fuliza cost you KSh 87

items.headline: KSh 4,000 sent to Mum
items.body: Money sent to family and friends doubled compared with last week. It is counted as spending, not a transfer.

items.headline: A new place: Quickmart Kangemi

items.headline: KSh 2,000 withdrawn as cash
items.body: Cash is shown as a transfer. Matatu and boda fares you add by hand show up under transport.

items.headline: You saved 43% of what came in
items.body: KSh 5,000 went to M-Shwari from KSh 11,700 received. Savings are kept out of spending.

sections.title: M-Pesa ended the week at KSh 4,318
sections.alt_text: M-Pesa balance over the week, from KSh 2,840 spent on Monday to a closing balance of KSh 4,318 on Sunday.

sections.title: Three things to watch next week
items: Safaricom Home Fibre is due on 15 October, usually KSh 2,999.
Transport is projected to reach KSh 12,860, past its KSh 12,000 budget.
Your M-Pesa balance is KSh 4,318. Fuliza kicks in again if it runs out before Friday.
